programme.desc: The triumphs and tragedies of Katrinka Kovár, a young Czechoslovakian ski prodigy who discovers high-society splendor in the arms of a wealthy American businessman. When lust turns to lies, Katrinka--long haunted by a burning secret from her past--sets out to find the love she left behind.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: The Yeltsin Project
programme.desc: Russian political elite hires American consultants to help with President Yeltsin's re-election campaign when his approval rating is down to single digits.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Zalgiris Kaunas - Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Out There with Jack Randall
programme.desc: At the tender age of 14, Jack Randall left his home in the UK to work under the guidance of legendary wildlife expert Steve Irwin. Developing his skills of handling reptiles and snakes, Randall learned important skills under Irwin's tutelage that remain with him today. Now an accomplished zoologist, Randall is continuing his studies into wild and exotic species, visiting harsh landscapes and unrelenting environments to explore these animal's behaviours. Using his bold and courageous approach, Randall gets up close and personal with deadly snakes, vicious crocodiles, boisterous kangaroos, fierce camels and many other dangerous species.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: In the wake of the largest volcanic eruption of the 1900s, an exploration by National Geographic led to the founding of Katmai National Park. From the volcanic ashes, the landscape regenerated, and a vibrant assembly of wildlife emerged. Witness the annual journey of brown bears, wolves, and salmon within the park.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Zion's iconic landscapes feature soaring red spires against a clear blue sky. Beyond canyons and cliffs, water emerges as a surprising force. The humble Virgin River, sculpting a geologic masterpiece over millennia, sustains diverse life in Zion National Park. Climbers, bighorn sheep, wild turkeys, and globe mallow bees all find refuge alongside this flowing lifeline.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Experience a year in Yellowstone, the worlds first national park. Meet remarkable wildlife, from the steadfast Wapiti wolves and resilient bison to playful grizzly cubs. Discover the parks indigenous heritage, ecological diversity, and geological wonders. Home to the largest collection of geysers on the planet, this American trailblazer shapes how we value and safeguard our most precious lands.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: The lines between hunter and hunted become blurred in this epic safari. Hold on to your seats as an elephant charges through the bush with a lion dangling from its tusks. Watch as male leopards engage in a turf war, and a pack of hyenas bully a lion off of his buffalo kill. The safari intensifies as a leopard, wild dogs and hyenas fight for the same kill in an astonishing display of raw nature.

programme.desc: Whether right whales, penguins or sea lions - for the birth of their young, many marine creatures are drawn to Argentina's nearly 5,000 kilometer coastline. programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: In Argentina's breathtaking, yet imposing wilderness, every day is a fight for survival. The terrain is rugged and parched. The air is thin. The weather can change in an instant. And then there are the predators. A female puma stalks a valley in search of guanaco, while a tarantula defends itself against a hungry armadillo. Foxes will scavenge what they can…until one of the world's largest vultures shows up. All the while, in the background, glaciers greedily hold on to the freshwater these animals so desperately need.

programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Typically South Africa is known for the Big Five: lions, leopards, buffalo, elephants and rhinos. But not for Lucy Cooke, advocate and avenger for the lesser-known and unloved animals of the world. Lucy's on a hunt for the more enigmatic Freaky Five: Cape vultures, sungazer girdled lizards, golden-brown baboon tarantulas, ground pangolins, and chacma baboons. The Freaky Five are all important to South Africans and their traditions. Mystical and mysterious, these five animals represent a side of South African culture that the tourists and conservation donors both often overlook. But Lucy Cooke is on a mission to change all of that!

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Lucy Cooke is on a one-woman mission to show why the ugly, weird and overlooked animals of the world can be cute, cuddly and deserving of attention. Join her as she heads off to the rainforests of Borneo. Borneo is its own very unique crucible of weirdness - with countless strange creatures that can only be found there. Lucy's goal is get up close with the giant-nosed proboscis monkey to figure out why this creature looks so strange. Along the way, she finds many other "odd ones" - animals that have come up with all kinds of strange adaptations so they can survive in the forest of Borneo. Lucy finds dung beetles in action - eating dung; frogs that fly; a tarsier, with eyes that are bigger than its brain; and the wooly bat that makes its home is a carnivorous plant.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sette Oscar e un Golden Globe al film di fantascienza di Alfonso Cuaron, con Sandra Bullock e George Clooney. La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: La stranezza
programme.desc: 4 David di Donatello al film di Roberto Andò con Toni Servillo affiancato dal duo comico Ficarra e Picone. Sicilia, 1920: l'incontro con due scapestrati becchini con la vocazione per il teatro ispira a Luigi Pirandello la stesura di "Sei personaggi in cerca d'autore".

programme.title: J. Edgar
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: The Blues Brothers
programme.desc: John Belushi e Dan Aykroyd nell'irriverente commedia musicale di John Landis. Per salvare l'orfanotrofio in cui sono cresciuti, due fratelli riuniscono la loro band per un concerto.

programme.title: Giurato numero 2
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: A beautiful mind
programme.desc: 4 Oscar e 4 Golden Globe per il capolavoro di Ron Howard con Russell Crowe e Jennifer Connelly. L'avvincente biografia di John Nash, genio matematico e premio Nobel affetto da schizofrenia.

programme.title: C'era una volta il West
programme.desc: Henry Fonda e Claudia Cardinale nel western che ha consacrato il mito di Sergio Leone. Un magnate delle ferrovie ingaggia un killer per impadronirsi del terreno di un'ex prostituta.

programme.title: Qui rido io
programme.desc: Toni Servillo interpreta Eduardo Scarpetta nel biopic di Mario Martone premiato con 2 David di Donatello 2022. La storia dell'attore napoletano da cui sono nati i tre fratelli De Filippo.

programme.desc: 3 premi Oscar 2022 al remake di Sian Heder premiato al Sundance. Ruby, unica udente in una famiglia di sordomuti, sogna un futuro nel canto ma non vuole lasciare i suoi cari.

Figlio di genitori ebrei, Mose' viene allevato dalla sorella del Faraone d'Egitto. Quando scopre di essere l'ebreo eletto da Dio rinuncia a tutti i suoi privilegi acquisiti, per liberare il suo popolo e condurlo verso la Terra Promessa: un racconto epico che si snoda tra i pericoli dell'attraversamento del Mar Rosso e l'ascesa al Sinai, con la consegna delle Tavole della Legge.

programme.title: Harry Potter e l'Ordine della Fenice

programme.title: Harry Potter e i doni della morte: Parte I

programme.desc: Oscar al miglior film straniero per uno dei capolavori di Fellini. Romagna anni '30: l'adolescente Titta vive le prime esperienze di vita, fra sogni, ricordi e personaggi grotteschi.

programme.title: Cosa sarà
programme.desc: Francesco Bruni dirige Kim Rossi Stuart in un racconto autobiografico sul tema della fragilita'. La diagnosi di una malattia costringe un regista a rivalutare i suoi legami personali.

programme.title: L'arminuta
programme.desc: 1 David di Donatello al film di Giuseppe Bonito dal bestseller di Donatella Di Pietrantonio. Una tredicenne torna dalla sua famiglia biologica, passando da una vita agiata alla poverta'.

programme.title: Tre piani
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti adatta il romanzo di Eshkol Nevo in una pellicola di cui è anche interprete insieme a Margherita Buy, Riccardo Scamarcio e Alba Rohrwacher. Solitudini, amori e ossessioni si intrecciano nei destini di tre famiglie di uno stesso palazzo della Roma bene.

programme.title: Ogni maledetta domenica
programme.desc: Oliver Stone dirige Al Pacino e un cast di divi per descrivere il mondo del football americano attraverso la storia di un allenatore in crisi, alla guida di una squadra che non sa piu' vincere. Tony D'Amato e i suoi Miami Sharks perdono una partita dietro l'altra, il quarterback titolare e' fuori per infortunio e la giovane e affascinante proprietaria della squadra e' decisa a far fuori il coach. Ma mandarlo via non e' per nulla facile, la squadra e' con Tony e tra un problema e l'altro riesce a qualificarsi per i playoff. Dentro o fuori, non ci sono alternative.

programme.title: La migliore offerta
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige il premio Oscar Geoffrey Rush in un'intensa pellicola. La vita di un antiquario viene sconvolta dal segreto nascosto nei sotterranei di una villa.

programme.title: A proposito di Schmidt
programme.desc: 2 Golden Globe al film di Alexander Payne con Jack Nicholson e Kathy Bates. Un vedovo attraversa l'America in un viaggio alla scoperta delle sue emozioni più profonde.

programme.title: Il ladro di giorni
programme.desc: Guido Lombardi dirige un road movie con Riccardo Scamarcio e Massimo Popolizio. Uscito di prigione, Vincenzo riallaccia i rapporti con il figlio durante un viaggio dal nord fino in Puglia.

programme.title: Julieta
programme.desc: Ispirandosi a tre racconti di Alice Munro, Pedro Almodovar dipinge un ritratto femminile. Una donna ripercorre il passato per raccontare alla figlia i segreti della propria vita.

programme.title: Favolacce
programme.desc: Elio Germano nella favola nera dei fratelli D’Innocenzo, premiati a Berlino e con 5 Nastri d'Argento. Periferia di Roma: in una comunità di famiglie la rabbia è sul punto di esplodere.

programme.title: Trilogia di Istanbul - Muhabbet
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek ritorna alla sua terra natale con tre cortometraggi. Una tavola circondata da amici alimenta conversazioni intime che si chiamano Muhabbet.

programme.title: 2 single a nozze
programme.desc: Commedia di culto con Owen Wilson e Vince Vaughn. Due amici si imbucano ai matrimoni per mangiare e rimorchiare ma alle nozze della figlia di un senatore finiscono nei pasticci.

programme.title: Miami Beach
programme.desc: Ricky Memphis e Max Tortora in una commedia vacanziera di Carlo Vanzina. Le spiagge e il mare della Florida incorniciano le comiche peripezie di un gruppo di ragazzi e dei loro genitori.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson e Zac Efron nell'action comedy ispirata alla serie tv anni '90. Mitch e il suo team di bagnini devono sgominare una pericolosa banda di trafficanti di droga.

programme.title: Contromano
programme.desc: Graffiante commedia di e con Antonio Albanese. Un commerciante milanese escogita un piano per liberarsi di un venditore ambulante senegalese che gli sta facendo concorrenza.

programme.desc: Commedia fiabesca di e con Alessandro Siani al fianco di Christian De Sica. Ingannato da una principessa, lo squattrinato Antonio stravolge i protocolli di corte con la sua spontaneita'.

programme.desc: New York: L'apertura di un antico e misterioso manufatto risveglia dal sonno eterno un esercito di demoni malvagi e la Terra rischia una nuova era glaciale. Vecchi e nuovi ghostbusters si uniscono per evitare l'Apocalisse.

programme.desc: Christian De Sica e Rocco Papaleo in una commedia di Luca Miniero. Un preside interessato al gemellaggio con una scuola ghanese invia per errore la proposta a un istituto napoletano.

programme.desc: La fantasia incontenibile di Tim Burton per l'atteso sequel con Michael Keaton, Winona Ryder, Jenna Ortega e Monica Bellucci. Per salvare la figlia dal regno dei morti, Lydia stringe un patto con il dispettoso Beetlejuice, che a sua volta deve liberarsi dell'ex moglie Delores.

programme.desc: Enrico Brignano, Ilaria Spada e Vanessa Incontrada nella commedia degli equivoci di Alessio Maria Federici. Un imbranato shampista per cani viene scambiato per un rinomato gigolo'.

programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Lillo & Greg, star di una commedia degli equivoci con Anna Foglietta e Francesco Mura. Due ex compagni di scuola decidono di scambiarsi i rispettivi codici genetici.

programme.title: Ocean's 8
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock, Cate Blanchett, Anne Hathaway e Rihanna in un'action-comedy dal regista di "Hunger Games'. Dopo cinque anni in carcere a preparare il colpo perfetto, Debbie Ocean passa all'azione e raduna una squadra di rapinatrici: vuole approfittare di una festa da ballo per rubare una collana di diamanti del valore di 150 milioni di dollari custodita all'interno del Metropolitan Museum di New York. Sequel in versione femminile della trilogia formata da "Ocean's Eleven - Fate il vostro gioco', "Ocean's Twelve' e "Ocean's Thirteen', diretta da Steven Soderbergh, qui in veste di produttore.

programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: Scared Shrekless
programme.desc: Shrek gets in the Halloween spirit by challenging his fairytale friends to come up with scary stories for a contest. But the gang learn that they'll have to spend the night in Lord Farquaad's haunted castle before the winner is named.

programme.title: Madly Madagascar
programme.desc: Romance is in the air for Alex, Marty, Gloria and Melman after King Julien discovers a magical perfume and takes on the role as \"King of Love.\".

programme.title: The Pig Who Cried Werewolf
programme.desc: The Three Pigs live in a house together, but Heimlich gets scared when he sees Wolf move in next door and acting strange.

programme.title: The Ghost of Lord Farquaad
programme.desc: Shrek, Fiona, and Donkey are on their way to the hotel where Shrek and Fiona will spend their honeymoon when they encounter Lord Farquaad's ghost!

programme.title: Megamind: The Button of Doom
programme.desc: After one \"button\" unleashes the gigantic robot MEGA-MEGAmind on Metro City, MegaMind and Minion must rely on their old tricks to restore order.

programme.title: Monsters vs Aliens: Mutant Pumpkins from Outer Space
programme.desc: Susan Murphy (a.k.a. Ginormica) and the Monsters are now working with the US government as special ops. So when an alien presence is detected in Susan's hometown of Modesto, California -- right before Halloween -- the team is dispatched to investigate. Everything appears normal, right down to the jack-o-lanterns peering out from every doorstep and windowsill. But when Halloween arrives, those innocent-looking carved pumpkins reveal themselves for what they really are mutant aliens. The altered pumpkins then start to implement their fiendish plan to take over Earth. The Monsters are there to combat the mutant gourds and try to smash their wicked scheme!

programme.title: Puss in Boots: The Three Diablos
programme.desc: After Puss in Boots is captured by soldiers he is enlisted to re-steal the priceless “Heart of Fire Ruby” a ruby stolen by the notorious, wicked and impossible-to-hear villain, known as The Whisperer. Puss must partner with the villain's henchmen, The Three Little Kittens, to seize the ruby. Babysitting has never been more dangerous. Will our hero Puss in Boots tame the Three Diablos in time to recover the ruby?

programme.desc: Watch your favorite Shrek characters sing the night away in this hilarious spoof. Join in the fun as Fiona, Puss in Boots, Donkey and the rest of the Far Far Away Kingdom battle it out in a singer's showdown.

programme.title: Catch Me I'm In Love
programme.desc: Two young adults search for that something that could complete their existence. The two would fall in love but conflict would arise to try to break their special bond.

programme.title: Daddy O, Baby O
programme.desc: A middle aged bachelor Mario spent his life taking care of his eccentric sister Brenda. He sells goodies in a mobile cart for a living. His daily routine gets a sudden turnaround when his dying friend Arnold made him promise to take care of his daughter Ana. But Ana is not just an ordinary little girl, despite her angelic look; she is cunning and mischievous who is in search of her estranged mother. Mario and Ana agreed that they would earn money to look for Ana’s mother in Cebu, but Ana should tame down. Mario performs his new task as a father to the orphan child in a very unconventional way. But through the help of a beautiful teacher named Maribel, he would always keep things going.

programme.title: Just The 3 Of Us
programme.desc: A one night stand becomes something much more for two people that don't really like each other very much when the girl gets pregnant.

programme.title: Kasal, Kasali, Kasalo
programme.desc: Jed is on the brink of leaving the Philippines to join his family in America when a run-in with the perfect woman, Angie, changes everything. A speedy proposal sends both families reeling and sets the stage for a rocky marriage.

programme.title: Momzillas
programme.desc: Two moms are drawn into direct conflict when their children announce their intentions to get married. The mothers have to put aside their differences, however, when they are both marooned on a distant island.

programme.desc: Susan Murphy (a.k.a. Ginormica) and the Monsters are now working with the US government as special ops. Everything appears normal, right down to the jack-o-lanterns peering out from every doorstep and windowsill. But when Halloween arrives, those innocent-looking carved pumpkins reveal themselves for what they really are mutant aliens. The altered pumpkins then start to implement their fiendish plan to take over Earth. The Monsters are there to combat the mutant gourds and try to smash their wicked scheme!

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

programme.title: Extreme Ends
programme.desc: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.

programme.title: 10 Fight 10 Season 3
programme.desc: The show brings Thai superstars, singers, boxers, models and rappers into the celebrity boxing ring. Season 2 features a first ever Thai female match and Season 3 has two Olympics gold medalists competing for the championship. This unique boxing show offers all-round entertainment, with live performances, lavish costumes and real fights with blood!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: The Ultimate BROcation
programme.desc: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: MATSURI: The Heartbeat of Japan
programme.desc: Higashinada Danjiri involves a parade of decorated floats, pulled by teams of veterans and ridden by young performers that lean out over the crowd. 32 districts take part with their own float.

programme.title: Herbal Symphony #5
programme.desc: In Uda, discover Japan's oldest private medicinal herb garden, where the natural landscape from 300 years ago is preserved in a botanical time capsule, a sanctuary of the local culture and history.

programme.title: Living and Laughing with Illness
programme.desc: A Japanese organization in which people with mental illness discuss and consider how best to live rather than relying on doctors is spotlighted. We look closely at how they come to accept themselves.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: BIZ STREAM SPECIAL EDITION
programme.desc: A Recipe for Succession: From finding business successors to preserving prized recipes, this episode focuses on ensuring the survival of companies and products that are at risk of disappearing.

programme.title: The Beauty of Japanese Swords
programme.desc: Japanese swords, admired since ancient times for their beauty, are amazing works of art. This time, a blade wielded by Miyamoto Musashi, the world's most famous swordsman: Musashi Masamune.

programme.title: Direct Talk
programme.desc: Colon Erika is the artistic director of a choir for children with hearing and visual impairments. The group's aim is to make music accessible to all. She talks about developing a new form of music.

programme.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: Dengue fever cases worldwide have risen to 30 times their levels 20 years ago, with global warming connected to infection spread by mosquitoes, especially in countries such as the Philippines.

programme.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE(5)
programme.desc: Mornings begin early for fishmongers and vegetable peddlers at Nihonbashi Bridge, and here is a reason. They are not going to bow to the lord's procession. The bustling scene from everyday Edo life.

programme.title: Medical Frontiers
programme.desc: A Japanese research team, focusing on the fact that people briefly wake up multiple times during sleep, helped develop a device to prevent insomnia. This episode shares the latest insights into sleep.

programme.title: Spiritual Explorers
programme.desc: The bow and arrow, once a deadly weapon, has developed into the martial art of kyudo. We explore the way of the bow as a means to achieving peace of mind.

programme.title: KUMANO: Nature's Dynamism
programme.desc: The Kii Mountains are home to dynamic landscapes formed by a volcanic eruption 14 million years ago. Through beautiful time-lapse footage, we show the area's rock formations and rich ecosystem.

programme.title: Boy Golden: Shoot To Kill
programme.desc: The film is very, very loosely based on the life of Arturo Porcuna (Jeorge Estregan). Once upon a time, he was known as Boy Anino, notorious leader of the Bahala Na gang. But rival gangster Tony Razon (John Estrada) attacked him in his home, leaving his entire gang and his family dead in the ruins. But Porcuna survived, and now he returns under a new alias, Boy Golden, and he seeks revenge against those that did him wrong. Along the way, he meets Marla D (KC Concepcion), a dancer who also has a bone to pick with Razon. Together, the two carry out a dangerous plan to take on Manila’s toughest gangsters.

programme.title: Ulan
programme.desc: In this coming-of-age-film about self-love, Maya is a girl who has always held a pessimistic view of the rain, reminding her of failed love and other depressing things. Will the rain ever stop her in her journey to overcome past heartaches?

programme.title: When The Love Is Gone
programme.desc: A man struggles to manage the growing conflict between his family and his mistress.

programme.desc: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists the help of his newfound ally, Diana Prince, to face an even greater enemy. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to find and recruit a team of metahumans to stand against this newly awakened threat. programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).

programme.title: Bad Boys 2
programme.desc: Bad Boys kembali beraksi untuk menghancurkan perdagangan narkoba di Miami.

programme.title: The Man With The Iron Fists
programme.desc: Saat berburu harta karun emas, sekelompok prajurit, pembunuh, dan seorang pembelot asal Inggris pergi ke sebuah desa di Tiongkok dan bertemu seorang pandai besi baik hati yang tengah berjuang mempertahankan desanya.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme harus memperdaya sebuah grup yang membunuh manusia demi kepuasan pribadi.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Di Inggris pada abad ke-12, Robin dan kelompok perampoknya menghadapi korupsi di desa setempat dan memimpin pemberontakan melawan penguasa yang nantinya akan mengubah keseimbangan kekuasaan di dunia.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Tom Cruise berperan sebagai seorang tentara AS yang harus menghentikan terjadinya pembinasaan umat manusia akibat kebangkitan seorang putri dari zaman kuno yang telah memendam kedengkian selama ribuan tahun.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Lima teman masa kecil bersatu kembali dua puluh tahun setelah mereka mencoba mabuk-mabukan di beberapa bar sekaligus dalam semalam dan berusaha untuk mendatangi sebuah bar legendaris: The World's End.

programme.title: U-571
programme.desc: Terinspirasi oleh peristiwa nyata pada masa Perang Dunia II, film ini bercerita tentang awak kapal selam Amerika yang ditugaskan menangkap kapal selam Jerman yang membawa mesin sandi Enigma.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Seorang polisi tangguh, John Kimble, menghadapi tantangan terberatnya saat ia harus menyamar sebagai seorang guru Taman Kanak-kanak demi menangkap seorang bandar narkoba.

programme.desc: Satu-satunya orang yang selamat dari sebuah kapal penangkap ikan paus yang hilang menceritakan kisah tentang obsesi kapten kapalnya untuk berburu seekor paus putih, Moby Dick.

programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan kisah yang terjadi sebelum kisah Snow White And The Huntsman. Selama perang antara dua ratu, sang pemburu harus mengalahkan sang ratu jahat sebelum ia berkuasa untuk selamanya.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Deckard Shaw berusaha membalaskan dendamnya kepada Dominic Toretto dan keluarganya untuk saudaranya yang sedang terbaring koma.

programme.title: Around The World In 80 Days
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1872, seorang penemu asal Inggris, pencuri asal Tiongkok, dan seniman asal Prancis berkeliling dunia dalam waktu 80 hari via jalur darat, udara, dan laut menggunakan sepatu roda untuk mencapai tujuan mereka.

programme.title: Total Recall (1990)
programme.desc: Pada tahun 2084, pekerja konstruksi Douglas Quaid pergi mengunjungi Rekall untuk liburan virtual ke Mars. Namun, prosedur itu malah membuka sejumlah ingatan tersembunyi dan menjerumuskannya ke dalam pemberontakan maut.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Kegelisahan seorang pemuda keturunan Afrika-Amerika terhadap sambutan orangtua kekasihnya yang berkulit putih mencapai puncaknya saat ia mengunjungi mereka di akhir pekan.

programme.title: The Woman King
programme.desc: Film aksi yang diangkat dari kisah nyata ini menceritakan tentang Viola Davis yang memimpin pasukan elit wanita yang bertekad membela negara mereka.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Di Inggris pada abad ke-12, Robin dan kelompok perampoknya menghadapi korupsi di desa setempat dan memimpin pemberontakan melawan penguasa yang nantinya akan mengubah keseimbangan kekuasaan di dunia.

programme.title: Captain Phillips
programme.desc: Kapal Maersk Alabama yang tengah menuju Kenya dibajak oleh sekelompok perompak Somalia yang dipimpin oleh Abduwali Muse. Namun tak lama kemudian, Muse dan kapten kapal tersebut terjebak dalam situasi nan ekstrem.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme harus memperdaya sebuah grup yang membunuh manusia demi kepuasan pribadi.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen dan Peeta Mellark menjadi incaran Capitol setelah kemenangan mereka di Hunger Games ke-74 memicu aksi pemberontakan di semua distrik di Panem.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: During the Cybertron Civil War, Optimus Prime sends Autobot scout B-127 to Earth to form a base where they can regroup. Later, the scout befriends a girl named Charlie, who names him Bumblebee.

programme.title: Now You See Me
programme.desc: Four magicians who perform on streets steal a tremendous amount of money that belongs to an insurance magnate while they are pursued by police authorities.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: A soldier and his brother escape into the woods when their city is invaded by North Korean paratroopers. After their father is killed, the brothers form a guerrilla group to fight back.

programme.title: I Am Wrath
programme.desc: After corrupt cops are unable to catch his wife's killers, Stanley, an unemployed man, teams up with an old friend to avenge her death.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: The key aspects of filmmaking are explored, with behind-the-scenes insights and intriguing interviews with prominent cast and crew members.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: After a woman abandons her child, the Tramp finds him and takes him under his wing. As the boy grows up, the Tramp and the boy try to cope with life's trials and tribulations.

programme.title: Kristy
programme.desc: This is Film - Thriller Category.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: John Wharton, the captain of an elite task force, raids a safe house owned by one of the most lethal drug cartels with his team. Though the mission is successful, death awaits them.

programme.title: Modern Times
programme.desc: A factory production line worker is thrown out on the street for his manic behaviour. He then meets a young, homeless girl, who is recently orphaned, and tries to build a home with her.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: This is Film - Action Category.
